title: RNAseq Libraries Preparation and Data Processing
author: Laura Antonucci

steps.title: Extract and Treat RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA and perform DNase treatment using the Direct-zol RNA MicroPrep kit (Zymoresearch, #11-33MB).

steps.title: Enrich Poly-A RNA
steps.instruction: Enrich 1μg of total RNA for poly-A tailed transcripts via double incubation with Oligo d(T) Magnetic Beads (NEB, S1419S).

steps.title: Fragment RNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the enriched RNA for 9 min at 94ºC in 2X Superscript III first-strand buffer containing 10mM DTT (Invitrogen, #P2325).

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Carry out the reverse-transcription (RT) reaction at the specified temperatures and durations.

steps.title: Purify RT Product
steps.instruction: Purify the resulting RT product using RNAClean XP (Beckman Coulter, #A63987).

steps.title: Prepare and Sequence Libraries
steps.instruction: Ligate, amplify, and sequence the libraries.

substeps.instruction: Ligate libraries with dual UDI (IDT) or single (Bioo Scientific) adapters
Perform size-selection using one-sided 0.8× AMPure cleanup beads
Quantify using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
Sequence on a HiSeq 4000 or NextSeq 500 (Illumina)

steps.title: Map Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Map FASTQ sequencing files to the mm10 reference genomes using STAR with default parameters.

substeps.instruction: Calculate expression values using parameters: condenseGenes -count exons -tpm

steps.title: Perform Differential Expression Analysis
steps.instruction: Calculate differential expression using the getDiffExpression.pl tool of HOMER using default parameters (FDR 1 or |1|).

steps.title: Conduct Gene Ontology Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform Gene Ontology analysis using GSEA PreRanked on gene sets from the Hallmarks 7.5.1 repository, using the full list of genes from the differential analysis as input.
